role: Despite its name, holds the skipRRSeries decoding flag, the ReadingTag model with its 14 system preset tags, and the Color hex helpers.
types: ReadingTag: struct — user/system tag on a session (id,name,colorHex,isSystem)
state: mem:ReadingTag.systemTagDefinitions (private static table of 14 (suffix, English name, hex, @Sendable closure returning the localized name))
mem:ReadingTag.morning…menstrual (14 static lets built from the table, ids 00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000{1..E})
toplevel: Static let skipRRSeries = decodeFlag("skipRRSeries"); 14 static let system tags each initialised via definedTag(suffix) at first access. ReadingTag synthesized Codable/Hashable/Identifiable/Sendable.

flags.text: File named HRVSession.swift contains no HRVSession; HRVSession lives in SessionMetadata.swift — the name misleads lookups.

units.does: Builds a CodingUserInfoKey from a raw string, trapping with preconditionFailure naming the literal if init fails (only for empty raw).

branches.effect: preconditionFailure crash; otherwise returns key. Unreachable for the single non-empty caller literal

units.does: Memberwise initializer for ReadingTag; id defaults to a fresh UUID, isSystem to false.
Returns the SwiftUI Color parsed from colorHex, gray if unparseable.
User-visible tag name: for system tags with the reserved UUID prefix, the localized name for its suffix; otherwise the stored name.

branches.cond: isSystem and id has reserved system suffix
branches.effect: false → returns stored name (user tags, or system tag with non-reserved id)

units.does: Returns the last character of the UUID string when it starts with the reserved 35-char system prefix, else nil.

branches.cond: uuidString hasPrefix reserved prefix and has last char

units.does: Looks the suffix up in systemTagDefinitions and returns that row's localized name (each row carries its String(localized:) closure, LanguageManager.appBundle); nil for a suffix with no row.

branches.effect: its localized name; otherwise nil (caller falls back to stored name)

units.does: Builds a system ReadingTag with id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000<suffix>; if that string is not a UUID, assertionFailure and returns a tag with a random id.

branches.effect: debug: assertionFailure; release: tag with random UUID (isSystem true) whose displayName then falls back to English name. Unreachable for the 14 single-hex suffixes in the table

units.does: Looks up a suffix in systemTagDefinitions and builds that system tag; preconditionFailure if absent.

branches.effect: preconditionFailure crash at static-let init; unreachable for the 14 literals used

units.does: Returns all 14 system tags freshly built from the definitions table.
Parses '#RRGGBB' or the '#RGB' shorthand (whitespace and '#' stripped; shorthand digits doubled) into an sRGB Color; nil for any other length or a non-hex character.

branches.cond: not six hex digits, or Scanner fails
branches.effect: return nil; otherwise RGB from the 24 bits

units.does: Converts a Color to '#RRGGBB' via UIColor.getRed, each component clamped to 0…1 and rounded to the nearest of 0…255; '#000000' if getRed fails.

branches.effect: true → formatted hex; false → '#000000' (color silently becomes black)
